final_message:
The yen receipt test passes now, and all 18 tests pass.

The bug was in `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It always divided the amount by 100, so a receipt for ¥500 printed as `¥5.00`. Yen has no minor unit, so I added a per-currency exponent map (`JPY: 0`, everything else defaults to 2). Yen amounts now print with no decimals, so 500 gives `¥500`.

The change is in one place, but every caller goes through `formatMoney`: invoice lines, cart totals and receipts. Yen totals in those will also print correctly now. Other currencies format exactly as before.

I haven't committed the change.
